title: Save Account: 6.10% p.a. Interest for 4 Months on up to $1,000,000 (New Customers Only, $1/Month Balance Grow Required) @ ubank
body:
Deal: Save Account: 6.10% p.a. Interest for 4 Months on up to $1,000,000 (New Customers Only, $1/Month Balance Grow Required) @ ubank

[ConsumerOfPumpkinPie] Obligatory HISA sheet link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/145iM6uuFS9m-Rul65--e…
[Iggemo] Thank you. I just finished my 4 months with Rabo so looking for a new one atm. Ubank is my usual but 5.35 isnt great just at the minute.
[cook99] Guess I found a new place to stash money for 4 months, see you again soon Macquarie
[SkyeMG] you never had a ubank or previously closed ?
[GreenLego] Yes, I thought everyone here already had UBank.
[cook99] Wife hasn't had ubank ever, and spare funds go there
[lawyerz] Everytime the rates change I guess we're getting a deal per bank now…. For either savings or loan rates…
[artcvan] The $50 deal has same requirements: https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/972135
[artcvan] So unfortunate I signed up to Ubank right before their $50 sign-up bonus and now I have one month of 6.10%… nevertheless this is looking good
[minijumbuk] I think we as a society need to collectively resist rewarding companies or even straight up ban business models that rely on "gotchas". There is no sensible reason why increasing your balance by $1 should be required.
Just give customers a fair competitive rate and stop putting clauses in there to catch people out. It's disgusting.
[topherboi] You're acting like the balance requirement is buried deep in their T&Cs, they're quite transparent with their bonus rate eligibility.
[DoctorCalculon] I think you totally missed the point that @minijumbuk was making.
It is the silly games these banks are playing, e.g. increase your balance by $1, $200, etc.
FFS! Why is that even necessary?
[suti1] Requiring an increase in balance means the account is less rate driven for the purposes of APRA's APS210.
[minijumbuk] Is it really though if it's $1 and the bonus rate makes up almost the entirety of the interest rate
[fry001] Fully agree. It wouldn’t be so bad if the bonus rate was say just 1% extra. So if you grow your balance you get 5.35% and if you don’t you get 4.35%. But to give nothing and just keep it all is greedy.
[SAU] https://www.bankwest.com.au/savings-accounts/high-interest
5.75 for 4 month if U bank is no go
[tof] Nice. Just in time for the end of my Rabo intro offer.
